## 444. The master laws under each law of a record, computed from the Lean (MV)

Board item MV, on RA's line. With every record on schema 2 (DF3, §436 and §441), each law of a record names its declarations. MV shows under each law which of the five master laws (08 §7: closure, balance, finite runs, lumping, order) its declarations rest on by Lean dependency, whether they reach the grammar, and, for a central declaration, the measure's category. It is computed, not written into the records, so it cannot drift from the Lean the way a hand-written key would. It reads OU3b's measure, unchanged (`measure_grammar.py` and EC's `measure.py`), and follows the constants of the checker's cache as the measure does. The work is the AI's ([kit](../../../../2026-10-05-repository-reconciliation/architecture/mv/README.md)).

```text
Result(s): no new result; a view on the record pages, computed from the Lean dependencies of each law's declarations.
Delta: (1) tools/research/master_laws.py:
       - it runs the measure and reads its rows for the central declarations (dependence, category, reason),
         and stops where its own reading of the constants disagrees with the measure's (127 rows, all agreeing);
       - for each law of each record it takes the constants the declarations' types and values use, together;
       - it writes theories/becoming/results/data/master-laws.json, with the master laws whose anchors they
         reach, whether they reach the grammar (marked where through its vocabulary only), the measure's
         four-way dependence, each central declaration's category, reason and own dependence, the anchors the
         law defines, and the declarations the spine run does not have;
       - it refuses to run on Lean sources the latest core receipt did not check.
       (2) the record pages: one line under each law, as wide as its marker; nothing where the law's declarations
       no longer match the data or it has none. (3) the check: 'master_laws' reports, never as an error, the laws
       the data no longer matches and whether the core sources, the measure, its coverage, the dump or the generator
       changed. (4) RESULT-WORKFLOW: what the view measures and when to rerun it. (5) tests.
Premises: none added; the measure's anchors, grammar test and categories, as they stand.
Evidence:
       - on core receipt `20261029T104256.342764Z`, 3,653 laws in 462 records: 690 reach the grammar (49 through its vocabulary
         only), 643 rest on balance and do not reach it, 134 rest on another anchor and do not reach it, 1,835
         have no master law's anchor among the constants their declarations use, 342 cite only declarations the
         spine run does not have, and 9 cite no declaration;
       - by master law: closure 286, balance 800, finite runs 236, lumping 79, order 77;
       - two independent readers reviewed it: 27 findings, among them two errors on the pages (notes under laws
         10 and above broke the list; grammar-reaching laws with no anchor printed an empty subject), and every
         finding taken but one (below); a second reader rechecked the fixes;
       - research check, links and test pass, and the check reports the data current.
Boundary:
       - a measurement of Lean dependency only: an anchor among the constants does not make the master law the
         reason the law holds, and reaching none does not make the law no case of one (Continuity.Balancing
         states a balance of its own and reaches none);
       - a master law's statement on the grammar (08 §7) does not count, only its anchors, as in the measure;
         counting it is the measure's choice, proposed to its owner (17 laws reach a grammar form without its
         anchor);
       - the data goes stale with every core landing that changes dependencies, until the generator reruns (about a
         minute with the checker's cache); the check says so.
Output → input: each law of the account shows what it rests on, for the chapters' readers, the measure's owner (the
       laws of no master law are the gaps the measure does not count, being no central declarations), and the
       review packet's readers.
```
